name: devforgeai
description: DevForgeAI spec-driven planning skills for Claude Code: brainstorm ideas, turn the promoted ones into a PRD with traceable IDs, define the architecture (components, decisions and ADRs) and report which requirements are ready for epics, write the project's context documents (tech stack, source tree, testing and each layer's conventions) from those decisions and the conventions the user confirms, then group the ready, current-release requirements into epics, plus a documents updater that refreshes a repository's README, CHANGELOG and guides from its git changes, and a git workflow skill that commits and pushes work from a worktree, opens pull requests, merges them only with QA's approval and the user's go-ahead, syncs the default branch without losing data and prunes merged worktrees.
